name: Dice Master
subtitle: Formula math, color subtotals
summary: Choose the dice, tap the screen, and the total appears the moment they stop, with every value that went into it.

hero.hook: Choose the dice, tap the screen, and the total appears the moment they stop, with every value that went into it.

sections.title: Roll, and the math is done
body: When the dice stop, the result appears in large type with each value lined up beneath it. Choose the formula the game calls for, such as Sum, Product, Highest or Lowest. Give the dice different colors and each color gets its own subtotal.
bullets: 6 formulas, including Sum, Product and Highest
Subtotals by dice color
Switch between 3D dice and a 2D view

sections.title: Rules that fit the game
body: Set the faces, dice count and roll mode to match the rules on the box. In All at Once, tap a die to lock it and reroll the rest. In One by One, every roll adds to a running total, and going over the Sum Limit ends the round in a bust. Save the setup to My Presets and bring it back later.

faq.q: Where settings and history are kept
a: Dice settings, My Presets and Roll History are kept in the app's own storage. Deleting the app deletes them as well. iCloud sync is not supported.
Reset App at the bottom of App Settings erases all settings, presets and roll history, and it cannot be undone. A Pro purchase is not affected.

faq.q: A die that is not in the list
a: Tap the faces chip at the top of the screen to open Dice Settings. Tap the pencil box and enter any number from 2 to 100 under Custom Faces to roll a die with that many sides. Dice beyond 10 faces need Pro.
The 3D view supports 2 to 20 sides. Larger dice are shown in 2D.
The app starts in your device language. To change it, open Language in App Settings and pick one of 13 languages. The switch happens inside the app right away.

Dice beyond 10 faces, more than 10 dice at once, the Neon, Thunder, Gold and Flame skins, and custom icons need Pro. So do verdicts after you change a Quick Preset's rules. The d20 Check preset rolls without Pro.
Without Pro you can save 2 presets, and Roll History and Statistics show your latest 50 rolls. Older rolls are still kept in the app, and all of them appear with Pro.

If you switched devices or reinstalled the app, tap the gear at the top right and open App Settings. Tap DiceMaster Pro at the top, then Restore Purchase near the bottom of the sheet. With the same Apple Account you are not charged again.
Rolling, history and presets work without an internet connection. Only buying and restoring Pro need a connection to the App Store.
Turn off Shake to Roll under Controls in App Settings, and shaking the device will no longer roll the dice.

privacy.title: Dice Master Privacy Policy
intro: kvndh ("the developer") handles the personal information of people who use the Dice Master app ("the app") in line with Korea's Personal Information Protection Act. This policy sets out how.

sections.title: Purpose of processing
paragraphs: The app has no sign-up or login, and the developer does not process personal information about its users. There is therefore no processing purpose to state.

sections.title: Personal information processed
paragraphs: The developer collects no personal information. The app uses the data listed below, all of it kept in the app's storage on your device. The developer does not receive this data.
bullets: Dice settings and My Presets: used to pick up where you left off next time
Roll history: used for the history list and statistics
App settings (skin, sound, language and similar): used for display and sound

sections.title: Retention period
paragraphs: The developer holds no personal information. Data in the app's storage is deleted when you delete the app.

sections.title: Disclosure to third parties
paragraphs: Personal information is not provided to third parties. If you send a roll result with the Share button, the text you send is handled under the policy of the app you choose.

sections.title: Outsourcing of processing
paragraphs: No processing of personal information is outsourced. Apple processes Dice Master Pro payments through the App Store, and payment details fall under Apple's privacy policy. The developer does not receive payment methods or Apple Account details.

sections.title: Deletion
paragraphs: The developer holds no personal information, so there is nothing to delete on the developer's side. Clear History in Roll History removes your rolls, and Reset App in App Settings removes settings, presets and history together. Deleting the app removes all of its data.

sections.title: Your rights and how to exercise them
paragraphs: Because the developer holds no personal information about you, there is nothing to access, correct or delete. If you have questions, email us at the address below.

sections.title: Security measures
paragraphs: The app does not ask for access to photos, location, contacts, the camera or the microphone. Shake to Roll reads the device's accelerometer only to detect shaking and does not store those readings.

sections.title: Automatic collection tools
paragraphs: The app uses no cookies, advertising identifiers or analytics tools.

sections.title: Privacy officer
paragraphs: If you have questions about personal information, email us at the address below.

sections.title: Remedies
paragraphs: If you need advice about a privacy concern or help settling a dispute, you can contact the Korean bodies listed below. If you live outside Korea, you can also contact the data protection authority in your country.
bullets: Personal Information Dispute Mediation Committee: 1833-6972 in Korea (www.kopico.go.kr)
Personal Information Infringement Report Center: 118 in Korea (privacy.kisa.or.kr)
Supreme Prosecutors' Office: 1301 in Korea (www.spo.go.kr)
National Police Agency: 182 in Korea (ecrm.police.go.kr)
European Union and EEA: the data protection authority of your country (edpb.europa.eu)
United Kingdom: Information Commissioner's Office (ico.org.uk)
United States: Federal Trade Commission (reportfraud.ftc.gov)
Other countries: the data protection or consumer protection authority where you live

sections.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: If this policy changes, this page will show the changes and the new effective date.

privacy.summary: Dice Master does not collect personal information. There is no sign-up or login, and Apple handles Pro payments.
